1: 72% Malay seat BN has held since 2004; 2021: BN 51.0%, PH 24.7%, PN 23.6%. With PN now behind incumbent Rosli Abdullah, the pact starts above 70% of the 2021 vote, and Bersama splits the anti-BN vote.
2: 93% Malay. 2021 was tight (BN 49.1% vs PN 44.1%, majority 364) but those PN votes now sit with the pact; PH took only 6.8%. Caretaker CM Ab Rauf Yusoh (86% approval in Ilham's survey).
3: 91% Malay. 2021: BN 51.9% + PN 37.3% vs PH 10.8%. Straight fight with PKR's Mohd Jaini Dimon, who lost his deposit as an independent in Paya Rumput in 2021.
4: 78% Malay; BN 63.9% in 2021 (majority 3,104). PH stands aside for Bersatu, but Bersatu polled only 2.5-2.6% contesting alone in Johor and Negeri Sembilan in 2026.
5: 79% Malay; incumbent Zulkiflee Zin won 57.2% in 2021 (majority 1,825). Straight fight with Amanah; BN has held the seat since 2004.
6: 68% Malay, 15% Indian. PH won it in 2018 (52.4%), BN took it back in 2021 (41.6% vs PH 33.1%, PN 24.0%). BN + PN was 65.6% of the 2021 vote; Bersama's candidate likely takes votes from PH.
7: 62% Malay, 19% Chinese, 18% Indian. MIC won 2021 by 559 votes (39.4% vs DAP 32.1%, PN 26.6%). On paper the pact's PN transfer decides it, but a new MIC candidate and a 4-way split leave room; one analyst lists it as a PH target.
8: Most mixed rural seat (47% Malay, 36% Chinese, 14% Indian). MCA's Ngwe Hee Sem won 2021 by 938 (46.7% vs PKR 34.9%, PN 15.0%). PKR brings back 2018 winner Ginie Lim, but PN's 15% now goes to MCA and Bersama splits PH.
9: 67% Malay, 23% Chinese. PH won in 2018; BN won 2021 by 559 (40.6% vs PH 34.4%, PN 24.4%). Straight fight; BN + PN was 65% of the 2021 vote. New BN candidate Mustafa Musa.
10: 65% Malay; incumbent Fairul Nizam won 56.8% in 2021 (majority 2,993). Straight fight with PKR.
11: 78% Malay. PN-Bersatu won in 2021 (43.6% vs BN 40.2%, majority 530). Bersatu now runs alone, without PH (which stands aside) or PAS, against BN's Rais Yasin (moving from Paya Rumput). Projected BN gain from Bersatu; Bersatu's best shot, so rated Likely, not Safe.
12: 79% Malay. 2021: BN 40.0%, PN 31.7%, PH 28.3%. PH stands aside for Bersatu's Asmah Samat, but even full PH transfer leaves her well short of the BN + PAS base.
13: 62% Malay, 29% Chinese. UMNO won 2021 by 629 (39.7% vs PKR 36.0%, PN 23.1%), but hands the seat to PAS's Rafie Ahmad. UMNO-to-PAS transfer is weaker (78% vs 91%, Ilham), non-Malays are cool on PAS, and PKR fields heavyweight Azman Abidin.
14: 68.5% Malay, 27% Chinese. MCA vice-president Lim Ban Hong won 2021 by 876 (38.5% vs PKR 31.8%, PAS 29.7%). PAS's 29.7% now backs MCA, while Bersatu (ex-UMNO Ali Mohamad) and Bersama split the field.
15: 65% Malay, 28% Chinese. Closest seat in 2021: UMNO 35.8% vs DAP 34.8% (majority 131), PN 19.8%, ex-ADUN Norhizam 9.0% as an independent (now Bersatu). PN behind UMNO lifts the pact base to about 56%.
16: 46% Chinese, 44% Malay, and the Malay share is rising. DAP's Kerk Chee Yee won 2021 with 60.0% (majority 5,624). The pact candidate is Gerakan (15.7% in 2021); the model keeps DAP clearly ahead, but Ilham rates it close, so Lean.
17: 65% Malay. Ex-CM Adly Zahari (Amanah) won 2021 with 41.6% only because BN (35.1%) and PAS (22.7%) split; together they were 57.8%. PAS's Ridzuan Sarif now carries the pact. Model gives PAS about +9, but Adly's personal vote and imperfect UMNO-to-PAS transfer make it a toss-up.
18: 88% Malay; 2021: BN 51.1% + PN 28.5% vs PH 19.7%. Straight fight; BN has held it since 2004.
19: 55% Chinese, 38.5% Malay; the largest electorate (54,910). DAP won 2021 with 65.9% (majority 10,237). The pact candidate is Wawasan; the model margin is wide, but Ilham calls it close (Chinese turnout, Bersama), so Lean.
20: 75% Chinese. DAP took 80.8% in 2021 (majority 11,494); Ilham and other analysts rate it a safe PH hold. The test is how far MCA cuts DAP's share.
21: 64% Malay, 30% Chinese. UMNO won 2021 by 200 (38.4% vs PH 36.7%, PN 23.5%). Now a straight fight, incumbent Mohd Noor Helmy vs DAP; BN + PN was 61.9% in 2021, and Ong Kian Ming sees DAP unlikely to regain it.
22: 74% Chinese. DAP took 81.2% in 2021 (majority 7,778); a PH stronghold since 2008. Safe.
23: 74% Malay (2021 electorate figure; 2026 breakdown not found). 2021: BN 43.0% + PN 28.3% vs PH 27.7%.
24: 62% Malay, 20% Chinese, 17% Indian. Bersatu's Yadzil Yaakub won 2021 by 328 (34.6% vs MCA 31.9%, DAP 25.4%); he now runs for Wawasan under PN with BN backing. Bersatu fields a new face; PH stands aside. Likely PN, with non-Malay votes the risk.
25: 67% Malay; 2021: BN 45.3% + PN 30.4% vs PH 24.3%. Incumbent Khaidhirah Abu Zahar in a straight fight with PKR.
26: 91% Malay. UMNO beat PAS by 79 votes in 2021 (43.3% vs 42.6%); the two are now allies, which turns a marginal seat into the safest kind.
27: 72% Malay; UMNO Youth chief Akmal Saleh won 58.4% in 2021 (majority 3,248). A bellwether for non-Malay support for UMNO.
28: 85% Malay; 2021: BN 48.1% + PN 33.7% vs PH 17.2%. New BN candidate Jezlee Pit.
